title: CastConnect
tagline: CastConnect: Your personalized social hub for posting threads, sharing frames, and connecting deeply with close friends. Like, repost, and engage with tailored content in a tightly-knit community.
description: CastConnect is your personalized social hub where you can seamlessly post threads, share frames and images, and connect with your closest friends in a meaningful way. Like, repost, and engage with content that matters to you, all within a tightly-knit community tailored to your individual preferences. It's more than just a social media app—it's where your closest connections thrive.
how_its_made:
* Next.js and Tailwind: Powering seamless front-end development.
* Farcaster and Web3Auth: Ensuring secure and decentralized user authentication and interactions.
* Neynar: Enhancing user experience with advanced features.
* Partnering with Karma3labs: Enriching the project with cutting-edge functionalities.
* Optimism OP Mainnet/Base: Integrating for scalability and enhanced performance.

Together, these technologies form the backbone of CastConnect, creating a uniquely personalized social experience for our users.
